deviations: PU items use the symmetric profile instead of tam-mediation's high-agreement profile, to make the 'PU attains 1 and 7' assertion hold robustly (high-agreement puts only ~0.8% of mass in category 1).
expectedTruths: Every indicator's permissible scale is 1..7 (model scale and columns.json scaleMin/scaleMax), but by construction PEOU items are observed only in 3..7 (observed min exactly 3) and BI items only in 1..6 (observed max exactly 6); PU items attain both 1 and 7.

IPMA performance must use the ORIGINAL endpoints: indicator performance = (mean - 1) / (7 - 1) * 100. Min-max rescaling with the observed extrema gives different values for PEOU and BI items and is wrong; for PU items the two coincide.

Indicator-level rescaled means (original endpoints vs. the wrong observed-extrema rescaling): peou1: mean 4.955000 -> 65.916667 (original 1..7); observed 3..7 would give 48.875000; peou2: mean 4.952500 -> 65.875000 (original 1..7); observed 3..7 would give 48.812500; peou3: mean 5.075000 -> 67.916667 (original 1..7); observed 3..7 would give 51.875000; peou4: mean 4.947500 -> 65.791667 (original 1..7); observed 3..7 would give 48.687500; pu1: mean 4.125000 -> 52.083333 (original 1..7); observed 1..7 would give 52.083333; pu2: mean 4.155000 -> 52.583333 (original 1..7); observed 1..7 would give 52.583333; pu3: mean 4.107500 -> 51.791667 (original 1..7); observed 1..7 would give 51.791667; pu4: mean 4.122500 -> 52.041667 (original 1..7); observed 1..7 would give 52.041667; bi1: mean 3.507500 -> 41.791667 (original 1..7); observed 1..6 would give 50.150000; bi2: mean 3.567500 -> 42.791667 (original 1..7); observed 1..6 would give 51.350000; bi3: mean 3.487500 -> 41.458333 (original 1..7); observed 1..6 would give 49.750000.

Construct performance depends on the estimated outer weights and is compared engine-to-engine; whatever weighting convention is used, it must be built from indicator values rescaled with the original endpoints 1 and 7, never the observed extrema.
